summary: feat(sentry-browser): add random per-browser user.id to Sentry events
description:
Because:

- Browser Sentry events carry no user id, so Sentry shows 0 users.

This commit:

- Adds a random id per browser, kept in localStorage, to sent error events.
- Creates the id only after beforeSendBrowser lets an event through.
- Sends the event without an id if storage throws.
